notes.title: Banker Simulator - Developer Diary #4 17.05.2025
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.gg/Qk2R329sEQ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/79f24103bab3b4891a6098a0aaf104fc2052fd28.jpg[/img]
[/url]

[h1][b]Hello Bankers![/b][/h1] 

With this devlog, we're excited to introduce many new features we've added to the Prologue version:

investment systems, credit evaluations, employee management, lifestyle elements, and much more are now part of the game!

Banker Simulator is no longer just a bank management game it's a full simulation of strategy, risk analysis, and a prestige filled life.

And this is just the beginning... We'll be sharing the release date of the Prologue with you very soon!

Thank you for all the support  it means a lot to us.

Now, here are some of the new features we’ve recently added.

[h1][b]What Did We Add to the Game?[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]Nightclub – Show Off With the Money Gun! 💃💵[/b][/h2]

What’s the point of being rich if you can’t flex it?

Take the party to the nightclub and make it rain with your Money Gun! Live the high life!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/5cf3331497526c943824d572019d7b6e95f79e4f.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Loan System – Who Deserves Your Money? 💳[/b][/h2]

Review customer loan applications, check their credit reports, and make smart decisions.

Choose wisely lend to the wrong person and your bank account might take the hit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/4c72652cf17fae63bf8bc0e7e46daef52466a786.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Stock Market – Win Big or Lose It All! 📈[/b][/h2]

Invest in stocks, follow company trends, and ride the wave of the economy.

Timing is everything without it, you're not investing... you're gambling!

[h3][b]Buy Stock[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/2cfbc0e409ffc75efff989aace040be6d36c51cd.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Profit or Lose[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/a25248e5e69c7dc7944bf87aaecf6b1adda70f46.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Graffiti Incident – Your Bank’s Reputation Is at Risk! 🎨[/b][/h2]

Local kids are tagging your bank with graffiti!

Reputation matters clean it up before the neighborhood sees you as a joke!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/6b20d332439fac5fc41a53a7130e88b829108d00.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Foreclosure System – Time to Reclaim What’s Yours! 🏚️[/b][/h2]

Some clients just don’t pay. Initiate foreclosure and take back their assets.

It’s not personal it’s business.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/f4a6de1f87792e8b251e45e6dd1540a267a6b09f.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Police System Play By the Rules... or Don’t! 👮‍♂️[/b][/h2]

Fake checks, shady deals, suspicious transfers — the cops are watching.

Keep your operations clean… or prepare to face the law!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/a84be27e69ffe6692bfae6d36a52a3548f33f6a7.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Bank Robbery – Expect the Unexpected! 💥[/b][/h2]

Banks attract attention not all of it good.

Be ready for armed robberies, boost your security, or... be the one planning the heist!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/9bdc04f3d2d25bbc9329d2a3da0a4f10c7bd8886.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Add to Your Wishlist! ✅ [/b][/h2] 

Add our game to your wishlist to stay updated and follow our development progress. Be the first to hear about new updates and announcements. Your support means the world to us!

Play Now!

Wishlist Now!

notes.title: Banker Simulator - Developer Diary #3
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.gg/Qk2R329sEQ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/79f24103bab3b4891a6098a0aaf104fc2052fd28.jpg[/img]
[/url]

[h1][b]Hello Bankers![/b][/h1] 

After a long and intense sprint leading up to the demo release, we took a short break. 
But don’t worry  we’re back and more excited than ever to keep developing the game!

We’ve also hit an exciting milestone: Banker Simulator has officially reached 15,000 wishlists! 🎉

Thank you for all the support  it means a lot to us.

Now, here are some of the new features we’ve recently added.

[h1][b]What Did We Add to the Game?[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]Investment & Credit Systems – Let the Real Money Game Begin! 💸[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Investment System! 📈[/b][/h3]

You can now invest in stocks and companies!
Follow live economic news, track the markets, and make smart investment decisions. Timing is everything  otherwise, it’s not investing... it’s gambling. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/a2a4682b425d24b3a1f44a3775f79c8a5f213158.png[/img]

[h3][b]Credit System! ⚖️[/b][/h3]

Check each customer’s credit risk report to decide whether they’re eligible for a loan.
Be careful! If you lend to the wrong person… you might end up in debt yourself. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/f8a1a1202644c89c3da9cab50252a65da3ae5874.png[/img]

[h2][b]Worker System – Time to Build Your Dream Team! 👔[/b][/h2]

You can now hire employees to help manage your bank more efficiently. Assign tasks, increase productivity, and grow your business one team member at a time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/c3ee9df8e1a0c215355d63176bbd56fe26a8b609.png[/img]

[h2][b]Car Gallery – Drive in Style! 🚗 [/b][/h2]

From modest rides to luxury vehicles, now you can buy status-symbol cars and show the world how far you’ve come. It’s not just about the money — it’s about the lifestyle. From poor to rich, literally.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/ebf8955440ab68cd1fa78dae0a1ccec9afe08e41.png[/img]

[h2][b]Home System – Your Own Space to Unwind! 🏠[/b][/h2] 

Buy and decorate your home just the way you like it! Whether it’s a cozy apartment or a fancy villa, your personal space now reflects your progress in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/961b56166539d32a17857b6af3e3d3059e04e11c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/38ca05fabb2240382aa698aa889d16224d1da4a7.png[/img]

notes.title: Banker Simulator - Developer Diary #2
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.gg/Qk2R329sEQ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/79f24103bab3b4891a6098a0aaf104fc2052fd28.jpg[/img]
[/url]

[h1][b]Hello Bankers![/b][/h1] 

It’s been almost two weeks since our last ''Developer Diary'', and we’ve been working non-stop to make the Banker Simulator Demo even better. 

Over the past 10 days, we’ve refined gameplay mechanics, added some exciting new features, and polished the visuals to create a more immersive and realistic experience. 

Honestly, we’re starting to think a coffee sponsor might be the secret to finishing this game! 😅

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/5ff86aa2f8ea163f6e1e180dd4e82641bac2f337.gif[/img]

[h1][b]What Did We Add to the Game?[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]Refilling ATMs, Powering the Bank! 🏧 [/b][/h2]

It’s your responsibility to keep the ATMs fully stocked!

Don’t forget to regularly load cash into the ATMs inside your bank and at your branches across the city. Remember, happy customers rely on well stocked ATMs, and an empty ATM means unhappy customers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/abc33cd1a56d33329fe22bbcfc930d0c8e1431b7.gif[/img]

[h2][b]A Clean Bank, Happy Customers! ✨ [/b][/h2]

We’ve added a cleaning system to the game! Now, keeping your bank clean directly impacts customer satisfaction.  So, roll up your sleeves and keep things spotless—because nobody likes a messy bank! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/0b3381409fb28e42a9db3447f16bf05aa10fbaf9.gif[/img]

[h2][b]ID Check at the Counter!🆔[/b][/h2] 

Papers, please! Just kidding well, sort of. We've added a new ID check system! 

Now you can verify customer identities in the database to catch any suspicious transactions. 

Stay alertthey might try to fool you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/37467b0cf3bdf39af5b194e86f107628f791e369.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Repairable Machnices!🛠️[/b][/h2]

We’ve added a repair system for your machines. When equipment breaks down, it’s up to you to fix it and keep your operations running smoothly. Regular maintenance don’t let a small issue turn into a big problem! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/ff6a46b6e60f35d17bca2319e820cd09a094b1aa.gif[/img]
